tailoring.headline: Platform Reliability & SAP Commerce Developer | Java, Spring & Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and production reliability for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. Proven expertise in production troubleshooting, performance tuning, operational readiness, and platform maintenance within agile environments. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] #platform_reliability_engineer #job_description
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in driving technical mechanisms for CI/CD, environments, and production reliability for SAP Commerce at Ajay Chowdary. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on backend and platform experience building and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to ensure operational readiness and system stability for your platforms.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Deployments
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, supporting smooth environment transitions.

bullets.label: Production Reliability & Support
bullets.text: Provided ongoing production support, investigated and resolved complex integration bottlenecks, and stabilized global e-commerce environments.

bullets.label: Performance Tuning
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, directly enhancing operational stability and system throughput.

bullets.label: System Integration & Recovery
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations and data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, ensuring robust data consistency and recovery pathways across enterprise systems.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing how my platform support and engineering experience aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce architecture, CI/CD execution, and production troubleshooting experience to Ajay Chowdary to strengthen your platform reliability and operational readiness. My background in maintaining high-performance e-commerce environments at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns directly with your technical goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce development, CI/CD execution, and production support experience to ensure robust platform reliability and operational excellence.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell focusing on CI/CD, production support, and performance tuning, I would love to discuss how I can contribute to platform reliability at Ajay Chowdary.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] #platform_reliability_engineer #job_description role at Ajay Chowdary.

With over 5 years of professional experience building, supporting, and optimizing enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in CI/CD deployments, production troubleshooting, and system performance tuning.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to speak with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
